meta_description: Nabo is a private community app for one apartment building: news from your manager, a feed of verified neighbours, events, lending and borrowing, and direct messages. Six languages, free for residents.
ld_offer: Free for residents. Buildings are billed to the property manager on the web.
hero_pill: Coming to the App Store · Pilot buildings open
hero_lede: Nabo is a private space for the people who share your front door. News from your manager, a feed of verified neighbours, events, lending and borrowing, and direct messages — without strangers, shared phone numbers or endless group chats.

why_lede: Every building ends up with a WhatsApp group, and every WhatsApp group fails the same way. Nabo keeps what works — quick, local, human — and removes everything that doesn't.
why1_after: Only verified neighbours, approved by your manager
why1_text: Nobody joins without the manager's approval, and nobody sees your number. Your profile shows exactly what you choose: by default, just your first name and floor.
why2_after: Categories, quiet hours, and a weekly digest
why2_text: Posts have clear categories, so you follow what matters. Choose instant, digest or off per category. Only genuinely urgent notices from the manager can break quiet hours.
why3_text: Every announcement goes out as a push notification and an email, including to residents who never installed the app, and the manager sees who received and acknowledged it.
feat_title: Everything a building needs. Nothing it doesn't.
feat_lede: Six things, done properly. No maintenance ticketing maze, no payments, no marketplace for strangers — just the daily life of the people who live around you.
f_ann_text: Water cuts, works, meetings and official notices reach every home by push and email. A per-recipient delivery log and optional acknowledgement give managers the proof they never had.
f_feed_text: Ask a quick question, recommend a plumber, find a lost cat. Fixed categories, comments, reactions and pinned posts keep it readable months later.
f_events_text: Assemblies, courtyard barbecues, kids' playdates. RSVP, capacity with waitlist, reminders, and one tap to add to your calendar.
f_lend_text: A drill for an afternoon, a ladder for an hour. Offer what you have, ask for what you need. The lender chooses, return reminders do the rest. No money involved.
f_dm_text: Message a neighbour or start a small group. First contact arrives as a request you can accept or ignore, and you can block anyone, any time.
f_tr_text: Buildings are multilingual. Any post or comment translates into your language with one tap — Albanian included — so nobody is left out of the conversation.
f_notif_text: Instant, daily digest or off, per category. Quiet hours that only urgent manager notices can bypass. A weekly email summary if you'd rather not install anything.
mgr_lede: Residents rate maintenance updates as the most important thing you do, yet only a third feel informed. Nabo gives you one channel that reaches everyone — and a log that shows it.
mgr1_t: Import units from a spreadsheet, approve join requests with the roster beside you, and run a six-monthly confirmation so it stays accurate.
mgr2_t: Push plus email to every home, including residents without the app. See who received, who opened, who acknowledged.
mgr3_t: Convocations and formal notices follow the rules of your country, record consent, and tell you who still needs paper.
mgr4_t: Community guidelines, reporting everywhere, a review queue and escalation to Nabo within 24 hours.
mgr5_t: Homes registered, reach of your last announcement, active neighbours this week, and pilot milestones at day 30 and day 60.

price_fine: Residents never pay. Billing is on the web by card or SEPA, with a proper invoice — no in-app purchases. Cancel any time.

priv_lede: A community app only works if people feel safe in it. Nabo is built around one hard boundary — your building — and the defaults protect you without asking.
p1_text: Nothing you post leaves the building. Every record is scoped to it, and that boundary is enforced in the database, not just in the app.
p2_text: Profiles show your first name and floor by default. Nobody joins without the manager's approval. Message requests and blocking from day one.
p3_text: Hosted in Frankfurt. Nabo acts as a processor for your building with a data processing agreement. No ads, no data sold, ever.
p4_text: Download everything you've posted, or delete your account in the app. Moving out revokes access immediately. 16+ only.
lng_lede: The whole app, the emails and the notifications are available in six languages, and every post translates with one tap. Switch at any time, whatever your phone is set to.
q1: How do I get Nabo for my building?
a1: Buildings join through their property manager or certified administrator, who sets up the building, imports the list of homes and prints the join-code notice for the entrance. If you're a resident, send your manager this page. If you're a manager, request a pilot and we'll onboard you personally.
q2: Is it really free for residents?
a2: Yes, always. The building's manager pays a flat monthly fee per building after a 60-day free pilot. Residents never pay, and there are no in-app purchases, ads or data sold.
q3: How do you know someone actually lives here?
a3: Residents join with the building's code and their unit, or through an invite from the manager. Every request is checked against the roster and approved by the manager. When someone moves out, their access is revoked immediately.
q4: Will I be buried in notifications?
a4: No. Each category can be instant, a daily digest or off. Quiet hours are respected by everything except genuinely urgent notices from the manager, and you can get a weekly email summary instead.
q5: Which languages and countries are supported?
a5: The app, emails and notifications are available in Albanian, English, French, Italian, German and Spanish, and any post translates with one tap. Official notice rules are configured per country, starting with Albania, Italy, Germany, France and Spain.
a6: Nabo launches on iPhone first. Residents without the app still receive every announcement by email, so nobody in the building is left out. Android follows.
cta_text: Three pilot buildings, sixty days, personal onboarding. If your neighbours are more informed and your manager spends less time on the phone, you'll know within a month.
cta_small: We reply within one business day.
footer_tagline: A private community for one apartment building. Native on iPhone, six languages, data in the EU.
footer_made: Made with care for neighbours everywhere.
